description: This Java class 'Sending' handles the process of sending signals with asynchronous responses, acknowledgements, and error handling, including monitoring and logging.

classes.name: Sending
classes.description: Handles sending signals with asynchronous responses, acknowledgements, error handling, monitoring, and logging.

classes.name: Sending.CommandResponseMonitoring
classes.description: Abstract class for monitoring command responses, success, and failure.

classes.name: Sending.AcknowledgementMonitoring
classes.description: Monitors acknowledgements and handles negative acknowledgement responses.

classes.name: Sending.LiveResponseMonitoring
classes.description: Monitors live response command responses and handles negative responses.

methods.name: Sending
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Sending object with context, response future, resolver, and logger.

methods.name: monitorAndAcknowledge
methods.description: Monitors the response future, acknowledges responses, and handles exceptions.

methods.name: acknowledge
methods.description: Generates an acknowledgement or error response based on the response and context.

methods.name: getNullAckException
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating missing acknowledgement.

methods.name: monitor
methods.description: Monitors the command response, delegating to specific monitoring based on response type.

methods.name: isAcknowledgement
methods.description: Checks if a response is an acknowledgement.

methods.name: isTargetIssuesLiveResponse
methods.description: Checks if the target issues a live response acknowledgement.

methods.name: monitorLiveResponse
methods.description: Initiates monitoring for live response command responses.

methods.name: handleException
methods.description: Handles exceptions, logs failures, and converts exceptions to acknowledgements if applicable.

methods.name: monitorSendFailure
methods.description: Logs and monitors send failures, differentiating between runtime exceptions and others.

methods.name: convertExceptionToAcknowledgementOrNull
methods.description: Converts exceptions to acknowledgements based on context and target configuration.

methods.name: getRootCause
methods.description: Recursively retrieves the root cause of a throwable, unwrapping CompletionExceptions.
